title: Florida Man Claims He ‘Teleported’ into Stolen BMW Before Crashing at High Speed
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Volusia County, Florida — On December 8, 2025, a man left his BMW convertible unlocked at Bicentennial Park with the keys in a closed cupholder. While he was walking his dog, his car was stolen. A few minutes later, the BMW crashed at Old Dixie Highway and Plantation Oaks Boulevard. Witnesses got the driver, 36-year-old Calvin Curtis Johnson out of the car and told deputies he was moving at speeds over 100 mph when he wrecked. Johnson then explained that he didn't steal the car; he teleported into it. As a deputy handcuffed him to a patrol vehicle, Johnson exclaimed, "You saved me from the aliens!". Johnson is being treated at an area hospital and will be teleported to the Volusia County Branch Jail on charges of grand theft of a motor vehicle and driving with a suspended license.
